TS31 was not in this snapshot; its future body is not a new speculative fix target.
fallbackNormalUIOnlyIfLaterRegression: Compare live revision/selected actual ID against this read-only snapshot first. If already matching fixedTopLeft, do nothing.
Use design profile504x894 before fixing. A preset preserves current visible rect; applying it while stretched would freeze wrong size.
Restore listed baseline absolute/local rect in normal UI if needed, then select anchor top-left only on these direct message/card children.
selector select[data-responsive-field="anchor.preset"] -> top-left. For exact fixed values after selection: position.X=localx, position.Y=-localy, sizeDelta.X=w, sizeDelta.Y=h; min/max/pivot=[0,1].
Use pressSequentially+Tab for numeric/text change; selectOption for preset; re-find fields after rerender.
Do not apply fixed anchor to parent viewport. It remains stretch-y with width fixed and top/bottom margins.
Save/reopen normal UI; independently verify actual device view390x844/430x932 and scrolling, since source calculations are not DOM/capture proof.

sourceEvidence.finding: Auto layout overrides transform; else rectTransform, inset, then percentage fallback. Percent child size/position uses parent changing dimensions.
Equal min/max anchors keep fixed sizeDelta; top-left min/max/pivot[0,1] keeps parent-local x/y offsets with upward positionY.
top-left preset captures current resolved rect; correct reference profile/geometry must come first.
Device width-match scaling changes logical height to device.h/scale; calculations below use this real function.
TS29 direct message/TS30 direct cards explicitly top-left; fixed wrappers may retain percentage children.

verificationBoundary: Fresh source computations and existing saved model only. No product tests, UI actions, actual CSS/scroll measurements or screenshots performed.
